summary: IDS feed s101_single is degraded due to 86.6% encrypted traffic exceeding the IDS 60% tolerance; all other checks (duplicates, missing VLAN, one-way, packet drops, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 86.6% of bytes forwarded to the IDS are TLS/encrypted without prior decryption or handling on the packet broker. The IDS needs full cleartext payload for signature matching but is receiving mostly opaque encrypted sessions.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot inspect payloads for ~87% of traffic, so exploit, malware and C2 signatures fail to fire and detection coverage is severely reduced despite the tool requiring full payload and bidirectional visibility.

recommended_fix.why: Offload decryption to an SSL visibility appliance or packet broker decrypt function before the IDS, or selectively filter/route undecryptable encrypted traffic, to bring the encrypted share below the 60% threshold and restore inspectable payload to the IDS.
